description: Figure: TAX-2 CNBD pocket residues compared with reference CNBDs and across nematode orthologs
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt, pandas as pd, numpy as np, json
plt.rcParams.update({"font.size":9,"font.family":"DejaVu Sans"})

anchor=pd.read_csv("out/anchor_table.csv",index_col=0)
orth=pd.read_csv("out/ortholog_table.csv",index_col=0)

cols=[c for c in anchor.columns if c not in ("score","pct_id")]
labels=[c.split(" ",1)[0] for c in cols]
sub=["TAX4_CAEEL","TAX2_CAEEL","CNGA1_HUMAN","CNGA3_HUMAN","CNGB1_HUMAN","CNGB3_HUMAN","HCN2_HUMAN","KAP0_HUMAN"]
M=[]; T=[]
ref=[anchor.loc["TAX4_CAEEL",c][0] for c in cols]
for p in sub:
    row=[]; trow=[]
    for c,rr in zip(cols,ref):
        v=anchor.loc[p,c]
        aa = v[0] if v!="gap" else "-"
        trow.append(aa)
        row.append(1.0 if aa==rr else (0.45 if aa!="-" else 0.0))
    M.append(row); T.append(trow)
M=np.array(M)

fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(13,7.2),
                      gridspec_kw={"height_ratios":[len(sub),len(orth)+0.2],"hspace":0.42})

ax=axes[0]
ax.imshow(M,cmap="YlGnBu",vmin=0,vmax=1.35,aspect="auto")
for i in range(M.shape[0]):
    for j in range(M.shape[1]):
        ax.text(j,i,T[i][j],ha="center",va="center",fontweight="bold",
                color="white" if M[i,j]>0.8 else "black")
ax.set_xticks(range(len(cols)))
ax.set_xticklabels([c.replace(" ","\n",1) for c in cols],fontsize=7.5)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(sub))); ax.set_yticklabels(sub,fontsize=8.5)
ax.set_title("TAX-2 CNBD pocket residues vs CNBDs of known cyclic-nucleotide binders\n"
             "columns = the 15 TAX-4 residues within 4.5 A of bound cGMP in cryo-EM structure 5H3O; "
             "shading = identity to TAX-4",fontsize=10)
for j,c in enumerate(cols):
    if "PBC" in c or "b7" in c: ax.axvspan(j-0.5,j+0.5,color="none",ec="crimson",lw=1.4)

ocols=[c for c in orth.columns if c!="pct_id"]
O=[];OT=[]
oref=[c.split(" ")[0][0] for c in ocols]
for p in orth.index:
    r=[];t=[]
    for c,rr in zip(ocols,oref):
        v=orth.loc[p,c]; aa=v[0] if v!="gap" else "-"
        t.append(aa); r.append(1.0 if aa==rr else (0.45 if aa!="-" else 0.0))
    O.append(r); OT.append(t)
O=np.array(O)
ax=axes[1]
ax.imshow(O,cmap="YlOrBr",vmin=0,vmax=1.6,aspect="auto")
for i in range(O.shape[0]):
    for j in range(O.shape[1]):
        ax.text(j,i,OT[i][j],ha="center",va="center",fontweight="bold",
                color="white" if O[i,j]>0.8 else "black")
ax.set_xticks(range(len(ocols)))
ax.set_xticklabels([c.replace(" ","\n",1) for c in ocols],fontsize=7.5)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(orth.index)))
ax.set_yticklabels([f"{p}  ({orth.loc[p,'pct_id']}% id)" for p in orth.index],fontsize=8.5)
ax.set_title("Same pocket positions across nematode TAX-2 orthologs (C. elegans numbering)",fontsize=10)
plt.show()
